name: @giga/watch
description: The one watch-history semantics shared by the fileserver and the interface (docs/61 section 2.5, docs/30 sections 1 and 3): entry identity, the watchedPercent threshold applied at write time, sticky watched, newest-first ordering, the Continue selection and the history page slice. Pure functions over the entry shape; no I/O, no store, no program's private types. React-free.
